description: The shared configuration interface changes to a dictionary, but registered Qwen3MoeConfig still supplies a model class.
trigger: Construct a valid Qwen3MoeConfig and pass it to Model.from_config; alternatively call compile_model with that config and reach its Additional tensors block.
expected_behavior: Select Qwen3MoeModel as the text component and allow compilation to enumerate component hooks.

finding.description: The previously recorded Qwen3 MoE component-interface mismatch is carried over unchanged; the shared RoPE-reader extension does not repair it.
finding.trigger: Pass an otherwise valid Qwen3MoeConfig to Model.from_config, or independently reach compile_model's additional-tensor block with that configuration.
finding.expected_behavior: Select the text model and enumerate component compilation hooks.
finding.actual_behavior: Qwen3MoeConfig still passes the bare Qwen3MoeModel class, which Config stores as model_classes. The factory applies membership testing to that class, and compilation expects .items(). These operations cannot consume the stored form. Direct callers include conversion/get_base_model, quantization metadata construction, model_init, evaluation, examples and tests; the inspected calls omit component. Fixed-model examples are affected only if supplied such a configuration, not merely by this Gemma3 addition.
